question: Mont Blanc is the highest peak of which mountain range?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Alps**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mont Blanc** is the highest peak in the **Alps mountain range**, located in Europe.
 
• It stands at an elevation of approximately **4,809 meters (15,777 feet).**
 
• Mont Blanc is situated along the border between **France and Italy**.
 
• The **Alps** are one of the most prominent and extensive mountain ranges in Europe, extending across eight countries: France, Italy, Switz
